设计意图： This factor combines a volatility-adjusted price impact measure (primary) with a volume tail asymmetry adjustment (lightweight modifier). The primary mechanism captures liquidity costs per unit volatility. The asymmetry modifier amplifies the signal when selling pressure is dominant (down volume > up volume relative to VWAP) and dampens it when buying pressure is dominant, as volume imbalance can

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 该因子 DSL 为伪公式/数学描述（含自定义变量与宏，如 I[...]、B=<rolling>(20)），非可执行的 FactorEngine DSL，无法自动拆解为算子链；语义见上方公式原文。

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 high：high
  4. 计算 low：low
  5. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
  6. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  7. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  8. 计算 avg_impact：impact.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  9. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
  10. 计算 base_factor：avg_impact / vol
  11. 计算 vwap：(volume * (high + low + close) / 3).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum() / volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  12. 计算 up_vol：volume * (close > vwap).astype(float)
  13. 计算 down_vol：volume * (close < vwap).astype(float)
  14. 计算 up_sum：up_vol.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  15. 计算 down_sum：down_vol.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  16. 计算 asymmetry：(down_sum - up_sum) / (down_sum + up_sum)
  17. 计算 factor：base_factor * (1.0 + asymmetry)
  18. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_with_asymmetry(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0 abs_ret = ret.abs() impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) avg_impact = impact.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() vol = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan) base_factor = avg_impact / vol vwap = (volume * (high + low + close) / 3).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() up_vol = volume * (close > vwap).astype(float) down_vol = volume * (close < vwap).astype(float) up_sum = up_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() down_sum = down_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() asymmetry = (down_sum - up_sum) / (down_sum + up_sum).replace(0, np.nan) factor = base_factor * (1.0 + asymmetry.fillna(0)) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_with_asymmetry'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_vol_adjusted_with_asymmetry']
